crossRefs.note: Then king David answered, “Call Bathsheba in to me.” She came into the king’s presence and stood before the king.
crossRefs.keyword: into the king's presence. Heb. before the king

people.name: Bathsheba
people.line: Wife of Uriah, later married David and bore Solomon.

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

translations.web: Then king David answered, “Call Bathsheba in to me.” She came into the king’s presence and stood before the king.
translations.bsb: Then King David said, “Call in Bathsheba for me.” So she came into the king’s presence and stood before him.
translations.kjv: Then king David answered and said, Call me Bathsheba. And she came into the king's presence, and stood before the king.
translations.asv: Then king David answered and said, Call to me Bath-sheba. And she came into the king's presence, and stood before the king.
